item.title: 500 new ambulances deployed to boost NHS winter response

item.title: Shoplifter sentenced after crime spree
item.description: A Worksop shoplifter has been handed a 16-week prison sentence after being linked to a series of thefts. Three shops across Worksop were targeted by Brett Riddell during his shoplifting spree carried out between 19 and 28 December. item.title: Amber cold-health alert expanded to all regions of England
item.description: The UK Health Security Agency (UKHSA) has expanded the current amber cold-health alert (CHA) to all regions of England.
